case_classification.short_description: Regular Budget vs. Actuals Variance Analysis

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: The task requires mapping actual results from the Consolidated Income Statement to the P&L Budget lines (GL Detail) for FY 2024. While the line items are structured slightly differently (e.g., breakdown of revenue by geography vs. product/service types, and different sign conventions where expenses are negative in the budget but positive in the actuals), they map cleanly for major categories like Cost of Sales components, R&D, Sales & Marketing, G&A, Finance, and Taxes. An expert modeler would quickly set up a mapping/reconciliation table to align these lines, normalize the signs, compute the absolute and percentage variances (Actual minus Budget), and answer the 15 specific variance questions in approximately 20 minutes.
